notes: CPU-stage smoke SLO (Decision D2). The k6 smoke run (scripts/perf/k6-api-workflows.js) runs with K6_STRICT_SLO=1 so any non-2xx fails it, and its summary is adapted (scripts/perf/k6-to-canary.mjs) into the canary shape assert-slo.mjs enforces. http_error_rate and status_5xx_rate are 0: the CPU-stage smoke serves only known-good 2xx workflows, so any 5xx or failed request is a gate failure. Provider and queue surfaces are fixture-backed in the CPU stage; their thresholds match zero error and bounded latency. The window is 60s because the CPU-stage smoke runs a single 1-minute k6 scenario set, not the 5-minute canary window.
